# physkernel
> Allocation-free sensor ring buffers, a CUSUM e-detector E-STOP (mean false-alarm run length >= threshold under Gaussian noise), swept-collision candidate-trajectory selection and a heuristic service-health controller, in Zig 0.16. Prototype; never run on hardware.

- `RtFusionKernel`: comptime-sized IMU/position buffers, Goertzel power, 256-sample baseline, e-detector with e = cosh(3z)exp(-4.5). No false E_STOP in 2,000 one-second noise runs; 3-sigma shift stopped in median 5 steps.
- `rolloutPlan`: cheapest non-colliding sequence among caller-supplied candidates (segment-vs-circle check). Not MPC.
- `SreController`: heuristic latency and error CUSUMs (not anytime-valid).
- `physkernel bench`: stepImu ~240 ns, rollout ~13 ns (M2 Max).

README.md is the source of truth, including measured numbers with hardware and commit.
